sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: speed, passing, right-of-way, intersections, highways and turns
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The default speed limit table is a graphic whose limits and road types extracted as text in reading order; each fact pairs a limit with the road type printed directly after it, and the table's unless-otherwise-posted heading appears on the following page [A01] (verify NJ-ROAD-D-LIMITS).
The lane marking and highway ramp drawings are images; only their short captions extracted, and no fact relies on the drawings themselves [A03].
The statement that New Jersey has more pedestrian injury crashes than the national average gives no figure, so it is not used as a fact [A05].
Statute citations printed after each rule were summarized, not copied; fines, penalties and the Safe Corridor list are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The default speed limit graphic (physical page 64) extracted as alternating limit and road-type lines; the dossier pairs each limit with the road type printed after it; confirm the pairing against the rendered page or N.J.S.A. 39:4-98.
